notes.title: Damascus Completely Free to Play!
notes.notes: [h1]Damascus Completely Free to Play![/h1][p][/p][p]... However we won't be updating the game moving forward. The reason for this is that we are working on the spiritual successor to Damascus, a sequel meant to be so much more.[/p][p][/p][p]So today Wyn and I have a special and strange little announcement. When we first started developing Damascus it was always our vision to create a sprawling deep pixel art, tick based MMO RPG experience. However in launching the game and spending over a year attempting to fix and update it we learned that we lacked the skills and were not yet ready to fully realise our vision. In our hearts we knew this meant we would need to do a full rebuild of the game, and after being extremely burned out such an idea seemed impossible. We also knew that we needed to level up our coding and discipline skills to 99, so that we would be ready to give you all what you, and what Damascus the game, as an idea and project, deserves. [/p][p][/p][p]So first things first, from this day onwards, Damascus will be completely free to play, all players will be credited with permanently renewing membership and will be treated as members. Thank you all so much for all your support all this time! We will continue to maintain the server for anyone who wants to play. From now on you can think of this as our "Damascus Classic" server. This announcement also comes with a server update, which will hopefully end the daily/weekly server restarts and bring some stability to the world, and if there are any issues we will be there to fix them and restart the server as needed. [/p][p][/p][p]Finally that brings me to what we have been working on and what our plans for the future are. We are busy creating what is the spiritual successor to Damascus and a game we are calling Journey To Jericho. This is a 2.5D pixel art MMO RPG with much of the game design that was loved from the original with many new additions and quality of life features such as animations and a better client side experience. We will also be greatly overhauling questing and adding tons of new systems and a new continent. This also includes a full server re-write in Rust to ensure memory safety.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/5f6a65a4d0702e7b631b9b8274a5a113b3ef2eb0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Galactic Frontier Kickstarter Event!
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch 1.31 - Galactic Frontier Kickstarter Event![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/990c3a2e5a9bbcb4d96f949cfa7aeb8c65efe919.png[/img]

Today is an auspicious occasion for us at Team Teal. We are starting a kickstarter campaign to raise money to fund Galactic Frontier, a game we have been working on alongside Damascus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/434b8e660b3b8c56dbc40466720fc97e1eeb7fca.png[/img]

To celebrate this we decided to create an event in Damascus, with the items that get dropped having a space theme to them. The event is simple. Around the world are 3 types of enemies of various levels and killing them will drop the cosmetics.

But we didn't stop there. Because we felt you deserved more so we actually created a 4 level dungeon which is actually a bunker, a lost remnant of a world long forgotten. Here you will encounter 4 kinds of robotic enemies, the likes of no one in Damascus has seen before. And at the end of the dungeon is Decimus of the Machine Plague, a multi combat boss with some spicy mechanics and juicy drops.

We'd really appreciate the support with the Kickstarter. We love what we do and getting Kickstarted would allow us to dedicate more time to making games.

[url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s6jQeYf17Ho"]Here is a link to our teaser trailer![/url]

[url="https://discord.gg/f6YAaAmSvr"]Here is a link to our discord[/url]

[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1627366243/galactic-frontier"]Here is a link to our Kickstarter Page[/url]

[url="https://www.teamtealgames.com/press-kit"]Here is a link to our presskit[/url]

Much love and happy grinding!

[h1]Patch Notes - Patch 1.31[/h1]
========================================
[h2]General[/h2]
+ Started the Galactic Frontier Kickstarter Event. It will run for 2 weeks.
+ In celebration of the event every person who logs in will get the first pet Brobot deposited in their Wardrobe.
+ Jimbos have been added to the game. Their combat level is 4 and they attack with melee.
+ Babooms have been added to the game. Their combat level is 19 and they attack with melee.
+ Claw Bots have been added to the game. Their combat level is 102 and they attack with melee.
+ Injectors have been added to the game. Their combat level is 138 and they attack with psychic.
+ Decimus of the Machine Plague has been added to the game. He is a multicombat boss. His combat level is 730 and attacks in 2 stages. The first stage is range and the second stage is psychic, with a special psychic ability that can hit up to 3 players from distance.
+ A Bunker has been added to the game in the north west of Dominia. This is a multicombat area and has 4 levels to it. All enemies are aggro. Enemies also have a 1 minute respawn time (excluding boss) in the Bunker.
+ A Dungeon Crate has been added just outside this bunker. If you die in the dungeon your items will be transported to the crate and players will have to pay the alch value to get them back. DIMs do not have access to the crate so if they die in the dungeon their items will be dropped on the floor.
+ Add the Ray Gun to the game. It requires level 80 to equip and is a range weapon. It has a 1 in 300 drop chance from Decimus.
+ Added Energy Cells to the game. They are the ammo required for the Ray Gun. All enemies in the Bunker drop different amounts of these.
+ Added the Psy Sabre to the game. It requires level 80 in psychic to equip. It has a melee attack distance. It comes in 5 different colours. Each colour Psy Sabre has a 1 in 1500 drop chance against Decimus which equates to a 1 in 300 chance to get a Psy Sabre.
+ Added Focal Lens' to the game. These can get used on a Psy Sabre to change its colour. They come in 5 different colours. Using a Focal Lens on a Psy Sabre will consume the Focal Lens.
+ Gave all dungeons slightly brighter lighting. 
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
+ Fixed a bug where equipping an item in the shield slot with Cursed Claws equipped would result in the player losing their charges.
+ Fixed a bug where players could use the actuators in their Actuator Pouch if it was in the bank.
+ Fixed a bug where rings would not drop on death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36973073/7ac62c3902aaf982f403b5509899b91dbae40608.png[/img]
[h1]Patch 1.16 - Exchange Update[/h1]
Oh my hat, okay it's happening, everyone stay calm. After a long month of waiting the Damascus Exchange is finally here. Player trades will now be a thing of the past. You need not ever interact with another player again. Goodbye trading channel in the Discord.

The Damascus Exchange can be found to the east of Split City. There you will be able to post buy and sell orders for any item you want or don't want. The exchange will always prioritize the lowest priced sell orders and the highest priced buy orders. This means that if the player wants to buy something instantly, they should put a higher than average price in their buy order. If the player wants to sell something instantly, they should put a lower than average price in their sell order.
